description: This file is an HTML document serving as the front-end interface for a database visualization tool. It includes HTML structure, embedded CSS styles, and JavaScript code responsible for fetching database information, displaying database lists, tables, and table data, and handling user interactions such as refresh, expand cells, and selecting databases/tables.

methods.name: loadDatabases
methods.description: Fetches and displays the list of databases in the sidebar.

methods.name: refreshDatabases
methods.description: Refreshes the list of databases, resets current selections, and updates the UI.

methods.name: toggleDatabase
methods.description: Handles expanding/collapsing the list of tables under a selected database.

methods.name: loadTables
methods.description: Fetches and displays tables for the selected database.

methods.name: loadTableData
methods.description: Fetches and renders data for the selected table.

methods.name: renderTable
methods.description: Constructs HTML for a table given data rows and inserts it into the container.

methods.name: renderCell
methods.description: Creates HTML for individual cell content, handling nulls, objects, and long strings.

methods.name: expandCell
methods.description: Expands or collapses a cell to show full content or truncate.
